what: ict-trainer-git-sync (scripts/ops/trainer_git_sync.sh on ict-trainer-vm) does a full `git fetch origin main` + checkout like the live VM's sync did before VM-SPARSE-SYNC, so any research batch that puts bulk caches on main (#22365: 21.6 GB of comms/research/**/streams/*.pkl) also lands on the trainer's disk. Give it the same treatment: fetch with --filter=blob:limit=5m and apply deploy/vm-sparse-checkout (or a trainer variant if the trainer READS some comms/research caches — grep scripts/training + scripts/ml first) before the reset, idempotent every run, with a simulated-repo test like tests/test_vm_sparse_checkout.py.
